description:
This plugin provides a tenant configuration for a new identity type, including search, create, read, update configuration, translations, feature access policy, and more.

        Use it on a tenant project that you initialized with the **Initialize project** action of MIT.

        Please refer to the [documentation](https://doc.memority.eu/setup-guide/latest/new-identity-type-plugin) before use.
